title: PTO blade clutch will not engage
shortDescription: Pulling the PTO knob does nothing — blades don't spin.
fullDescription:
Cub Cadet XT1, XT2, and Ultima ZT use an electric PTO clutch. When the switch is pulled, 12V should energize the clutch coil and engage the blades.

Failure modes are: failed PTO switch, blown fuse, bad seat safety switch (you must be seated), or a worn-out clutch coil.

fixSteps.title: Sit firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Make sure your weight fully presses the seat switch.

fixSteps.title: Check fuse
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the PTO fuse in the fuse holder.

fixSteps.title: Test PTO switch
fixSteps.instruction: With multimeter, verify continuity through PTO switch.

whenToCallPro: Clutch replacement requires pulling pulley — pro recommended.
videoSearchQuery: Cub Cadet XT1 PTO won't engage fix

faq.a: Should read 2.4-3.5 ohms across coil terminals.

title: Safety interlock prevents starting
shortDescription: Engine cranks then dies, or won't crank at all.
fullDescription:
Cub Cadet has a network of safety switches: seat, brake, PTO off, and on ZT models the steering levers must be in the outer (parked) position. Any open switch blocks the start circuit.

The most common culprits are a worn seat switch and bent brake switch arm.
symptoms: Starts then dies when getting up

fixSteps.title: Verify operator position
fixSteps.instruction: Sit, brake fully down, PTO off, levers parked outer.

fixSteps.title: Test seat switch
fixSteps.instruction: Bypass with multimeter to confirm bad switch.

title: Hydrostatic drive weak or slow
shortDescription: Mower moves slowly even at full lever forward.
fullDescription:
ZT mowers use sealed hydrostatic transmissions. Old fluid, low fluid, or air in the system reduces output. Cub Cadet ZT transmissions need purging annually.

If one wheel is weaker than the other, it's typically that side's transmission.

fixSteps.title: Purge hydros
fixSteps.instruction: Disengage drive, push forward/reverse 5x with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Check belt
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect drive belt for cracks or glazing.

title: Mower deck vibrates excessively
shortDescription: Strong vibration when blades are engaged.
fullDescription:
Bent or unbalanced blade is the top cause. Always check after hitting a stump or rock.

Worn spindle bearings or a damaged deck pulley are next likely.

fixSteps.title: Inspect blades
fixSteps.instruction: Remove blades, balance on a nail or balancer, replace bent ones.

fixSteps.title: Check spindles
fixSteps.instruction: Wiggle each spindle by hand — replace if loose.

videoSearchQuery: Cub Cadet deck vibration blade balance

faq.a: Sharpen if straight; replace if bent or thinned.

title: Engine will not crank
fullDescription: Dead battery is the typical cause after winter storage. Also check ground cables, starter solenoid, and safety interlocks.

fixSteps.title: Test battery
fixSteps.instruction: Should read 12.6V at rest. Charge or replace if low.

title: Mower cuts unevenly
shortDescription: One side cuts lower than the other.
fullDescription:
Deck must be leveled side-to-side and pitched slightly nose-down (1/8 to 1/4 inch).

Low tire pressure can also cause uneven cut.

fixSteps.title: Check tire pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Set rear to 10 PSI, front to 14 PSI typically.

fixSteps.title: Level deck
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust deck-leveling rods until blade tips are equal height.

title: Mower deck belt slipping
fullDescription: Glazed, stretched, or oil-soaked deck belt slips under load. Spring tensioner may also be weak.

fixSteps.title: Inspect belt
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cracks, glazing, or stretch.

fixSteps.title: Replace belt
fixSteps.instruction: Route new belt per deck diagram.

title: Mower drifts to one side
shortDescription: Travels off-line when both levers held equal.
fullDescription: On ZT mowers each lever has a tracking adjustment. Adjust until both wheels run at the same speed at full forward.

fixSteps.title: Equalize tires
fixSteps.instruction: Set both rears to same pressure.

fixSteps.title: Adjust tracking
fixSteps.instruction: Turn the tracking screw on the lever until path is straight.

faq.a: Always adjust the slower side first.

title: Battery does not charge while running
fullDescription: Stator and regulator on the engine produce charging current. With engine running, battery should read 13.5-14.5V. Lower means stator or regulator failure.

fixSteps.title: Test charging
fixSteps.instruction: Read battery voltage at idle and 3/4 throttle — should rise.

fixSteps.title: Replace regulator
fixSteps.instruction: Swap regulator if AC voltage from stator is OK but DC out is not.

title: Blades stop when reversing
fullDescription: By design, blades disengage when reversing unless the operator presses the RMO button each time reverse is engaged. Not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Use RMO button
fixSteps.instruction: Press the yellow RMO button before each reverse with PTO on.

faq.a: No — required by ANSI safety standard.
